intro: Designed for modern professionals, Enterprise blends functionality with style. Its sleek combination of wood and steel ensures durability, while smart storage keep your workspace tidy and efficient.

features.title: Effortless wire management
features.text: No more tangled cords! Thoughtfully placed wire slots keep cables neatly arranged, giving your workspace a clean and professional look.

features.title: Smart storage for all your essentials
features.text: The built-in pedestal provides ample storage, so your files, stationery, and daily work essentials are always within reach, keeping your desk neat and organized.

features.title: Secure your belongings with one easy lock
features.text: With a single lock securing all three drawers, you can step away from your desk with peace of mind, knowing your important documents are safe.

features.title: Effortless access with smooth drawer grips
features.text: Snap-fit plastic grips make opening and closing drawers seamless, adding comfort and ease to your daily workflow.

features.title: Designed for comfort, built for productivity
features.text: With single-side storage, the desk ensures ample legroom, allowing you to work comfortably without feeling cramped.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Enterprise Without Cpu Hanger Office Desk 1200 W
